claims: The Artemis II crew is scheduled to return to Earth on Friday, April 10, 2026.
The Orion capsule is expected to splash down in the Pacific Ocean off the coast of San Diego, California.
The Orion capsule is expected to splash down at approximately 8:07 p.m. EDT (5:07 p.m. PDT).
The total mission lasts about 10 days.
The astronauts are on a four-day return journey following their lunar fly-by.
Recovery teams will retrieve the crew following splashdown.
Recovery teams will deliver the crew to a U.S. Navy ship for medical evaluation.
The mission marks the first crewed flight to the Moon in over 50 years.
